checks.name: ck_execution_mode_identity
checks.definition: (([execution_mode]='MULTI' OR [execution_mode]='LEGACY') AND ([execution_mode]='LEGACY' AND [policy_id] IS NOT NULL AND [version] IS NOT NULL AND [version]>=(1) OR [execution_mode]='MULTI' AND [policy_id] IS NULL AND [version] IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_wpae_shape
checks.definition: (([event_type]='SET_MODE' OR [event_type]='INITIALIZE') AND [policy_id] IS NULL AND [old_version_id] IS NULL AND [new_version_id] IS NULL AND [old_active] IS NULL AND [new_active] IS NULL AND [new_mode] IS NOT NULL AND ([new_mode]='MULTI' OR [new_mode]='LEGACY') AND ([event_type]='INITIALIZE' AND [old_mode] IS NULL OR [event_type]='SET_MODE' AND [old_mode] IS NOT NULL AND ([old_mode]='MULTI' OR [old_mode]='LEGACY') AND [old_mode]<>[new_mode]) OR ([event_type]='REPIN' OR [event_type]='DEACTIVATE' OR [event_type]='ACTIVATE') AND [policy_id] IS NOT NULL AND [new_version_id] IS NOT NULL AND [new_active] IS NOT NULL AND [old_mode] IS NULL AND [new_mode] IS NULL AND ([event_type]='ACTIVATE' AND [new_active]=(1) AND ([old_version_id] IS NULL AND [old_active] IS NULL OR [old_version_id] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active]=(0)) OR [event_type]='DEACTIVATE' AND [old_version_id] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active]=(1) AND [new_active]=(0) AND [old_version_id]=[new_version_id] OR [event_type]='REPIN' AND [old_version_id] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active] IS NOT NULL AND [old_active]=(1) AND [new_active]=(1) AND [old_version_id]<>[new_version_id]))

triggers.name: immutable_audit_events
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER dbo.immutable_audit_events ON dbo.audit_events INSTEAD OF UPDATE, DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; THROW 51000, 'Historical records are append-only', 1; END
